title: Property Rental Yield Calculation
topic: Calculating hypothetical property rental yield using an explicitly stated annual-rent divided by purchase-price formula

questions.question: In a hypothetical scenario, a property is purchased for Rp 1,000,000,000 and generates an annual rent of Rp 50,000,000. Using the formula (Annual Rent / Purchase Price) * 100, what is the rental yield?
questions.question_id: Dalam skenario hipotetis, sebuah properti dibeli seharga Rp 1.000.000.000 dan menghasilkan sewa tahunan sebesar Rp 50.000.000. Menggunakan rumus (Sewa Tahunan / Harga Beli) * 100, berapakah hasil sewa (rental yield) tersebut?

questions.question: In a hypothetical scenario, a property has a purchase price of Rp 2,500,000,000. If the annual rent is Rp 150,000,000, what is the rental yield based on the formula (Annual Rent / Purchase Price) * 100?
questions.question_id: Dalam skenario hipotetis, sebuah properti memiliki harga beli Rp 2.500.000.000. Jika sewa tahunannya adalah Rp 150.000.000, berapakah hasil sewa (rental yield) berdasarkan rumus (Sewa Tahunan / Harga Beli) * 100?
